tokens.name: color-background
tokens.usage: Every screen, under the doodle pattern (18% dark, 7% inverted light).

tokens.name: color-surface
tokens.usage: Bottom bars, sheets, the solid fallback for glass.

tokens.name: color-card
tokens.usage: Surface 2: thumbnails, chat bubble, avatar plate. v2.0 has no cards; kept for the v1.6 components.

tokens.name: color-card-border
tokens.usage: Hairline: row separators. The only border content gets.

tokens.name: color-card-highlight
tokens.usage: Top edge highlight on glass (tray, + plates, sheets).

tokens.name: color-edge
tokens.usage: Dividers and tracks inside controls, progress segments. Too faint for an outline that must be seen: use color-control.

tokens.name: color-control
tokens.usage: Outlines of buttons, chips, segments, checkboxes and field underlines. 3:1 against background and surface.

tokens.name: color-primary
tokens.usage: Gold fill: the one pressable action per screen, progress, the + button. Text on it is color-on-gold.

tokens.name: color-primary-dark
tokens.usage: Gold pressed state.

tokens.name: color-gold-line
tokens.usage: Gold used as a line or text: active tab underline, selected segment, gold labels. 4.5:1 on every light surface.

tokens.name: color-on-gold
tokens.usage: Text and icons on gold fill.

tokens.name: color-warning
tokens.usage: Amber: soon, expiring, discount running out, Pro plan pill. 4.5:1 as text in light.

tokens.name: color-danger
tokens.usage: Red: late, destructive actions. Nothing else is red.

tokens.name: color-success
tokens.usage: Green: saved, all good, spent less than last year.

tokens.name: color-text
tokens.usage: Main text on color-background and color-surface.

tokens.name: color-text-secondary
tokens.usage: Secondary text, labels, units, hints and placeholders. 4.5:1 or more on background, surface and surface 2 in both themes.

tokens.name: color-text-muted
tokens.usage: Chevrons, icons, disabled. Reaches 3:1 for icons in both themes; never used for words, use color-text-secondary.

tokens.name: color-track
tokens.usage: Empty segments of bars, switches off, gauge ticks not reached.

tokens.name: color-stamp
tokens.usage: The film-date odometer stamp printed on the car photo. Only there, with a 6px glow.

tokens.name: color-tab-bar
tokens.usage: Tab bar: matte, same as the background.

tokens.name: color-tab-bar-border
tokens.usage: Tab bar top hairline.

tokens.name: color-vip
tokens.usage: VIP plan only: its pill and paywall. Never for data or states.

groups.name: Display · Tektur ExtraBold, 78% width, caps · upright; slanted only for heroes
Numbers and labels · Tektur, 78% width, tabular

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon to text inside a control.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Between buttons in a group.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Row column gap.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Button group side margin.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Screen side margin for rows and titles.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Between sections.

tokens.name: hit-min
tokens.usage: Smallest touch target. Segments (28), chips (34), switches (28) and the tray tab (27) sit inside a 44px hit box.

tokens.name: radius-none
tokens.usage: Everything. v2.0 has no rounded corners; only status dots are round.

tokens.name: slant-sm
tokens.usage: Horizontal offset of the parallelogram for controls up to 34px high (segments, icon buttons).

tokens.name: slant-md
tokens.usage: Buttons 36–48px high, the + button.

tokens.name: slant-lg
tokens.usage: 50px and taller: the scan plate, sheets' top-left cut.

meta.note: v2.0 language from the Maintra 2.0 canvas: Tektur + Fira Sans, contrast pass (color-control, darker light accents), cut corners, 44px hit boxes. Old token names kept so the v1.6 components restyle.

tokens.name: cut-card
tokens.usage: Cards and sheets: the top-left corner cut at 45°. Every other corner square.

tokens.name: cut-inner
tokens.usage: The inner layer of a two-layer outlined card, so the outline keeps its width along the cut.
